Class ProductService

java.lang.Object
org.codewithmagret.rest.product.ProductService
@Service public class ProductService extends Object
Service class responsible for handling business logic related to Products. Includes CRUD operations and manual sorting logic.

    • sortByPrice

      public static void sortByPrice(List<Product> products)
      Sorts products by price using Bucket Sort. Steps: 1. Determine number of buckets using square root of array length 2. Find maximum price 3. Place each product into its correct bucket 4. Sort each bucket 5. Merge all buckets back into the original list
      Parameters:
      products - the list of products to sort by price

    • sortByStock

      public static void sortByStock(List<Product> products)
      Sorts products by stock using Bucket Sort. Steps: 1. Determine number of buckets using square root of array length 2. Find maximum stock 3. Place each product into its correct bucket 4. Sort each bucket 5. Merge all buckets back into the original list
      Parameters:
      products - the list of products to sort by stock
